overallAcceptability: Not determined: no completed evaluator data or complete current physical acceptance evidence were supplied.

verification.postgresScope: Embedded PGlite for suites using PostgresTestStore; other unit/fixture tests retain their designed stores. Not a hosted Supabase test.
verification.protocolFixtures: Two synthetic Modbus/range/readback checks passed; no serial device opened.

performance.scope: Single cold-cache run per condition, isolated local backend, Chromium phone emulation. Service workers blocked for cold loads. No agreed performance threshold; not an LTE, real-phone or cloud result. Browser resource samples: heap sizes in bytes, TaskDuration in seconds, DOM counts dimensionless; one sample is not a peak or sustained-capacity measurement.
limitations: One cold-load sample per condition; no agreed pass/fail threshold, p95 estimate or capacity result.
Resource transfer totals include completed resource entries at the sample instant, not all navigation/pending traffic.
Worker caching is disabled for cold-load measurements; first-install precache cost is separate.
JS heap/task-duration samples are not peak browser/ESP32 RAM, backend CPU, power consumption or field-LTE measurements.

offline.scope: Public essentials plus compiled static bundles are cached after successful online installation. API responses, private photos and unapproved optimized images remain excluded.
offline.verified: Offline shell/logo/manual/public solar image fallback, queue corruption/quota handling, reconnect/lost-receipt deduplication, and unrelated-cache preservation.
offline.limitations: This is not offline authentication, offline private-history synchronization, offline map-tile provisioning or an unlimited/loss-free firmware buffer.

openGates: Actual IT-expert and TODA ratings using the approved study instrument/decision rules.
Current firmware build setup: attempted integrated/all-input compiles could not start because .tools/cpe-python is absent. Historical compile logs are not fresh results.
Reference-instrument sensor/GPS/energy accuracy, commissioned wind/controller channels and genuine full device-to-dashboard tests.
Physical power/reset/network failure recovery, bounded alarm cutoff and sustained soak/capacity measurements.
Real hosting/HTTPS/proxy/identity/retention/backup restore and actual SMS delivery verification; local paid services remain disabled.
Operator/controller identity, privacy contact and final policy effective date; address-provider selection remains deferred.
